business: SMS Buddy (smsbuddy.lk): prepaid business SMS for Sri Lanka, sent under your own business name
target: Owners and marketers of Sri Lankan small and medium businesses that run seasonal sales and already have a customer phone list
where: Sri Lanka, mostly Colombo, Gampaha, Kandy and Galle; selling in store, on Facebook/Instagram/WhatsApp, or a small online shop

segments.name: Social-commerce seller (fashion, beauty, gadgets on Facebook/Instagram/WhatsApp)
Physical shop or restaurant with a customer list (retail, grocery, salon, cafe)
Established online store or chain (own website, several branches)
Marketing agency or freelancer running campaigns for clients

behaviours.name: Already uses another SMS provider
behaviours.how: Has an account with Dialog, Notify.lk, Text.lk or similar and only switches for a clear reason.

behaviours.name: WhatsApp-first
behaviours.how: Sends offers through WhatsApp broadcasts and groups, has never paid for SMS.

behaviours.name: Price comparer
behaviours.how: Lines up per-SMS rates from three providers before paying anything.

behaviours.name: Last-minute planner
behaviours.how: Decides the sale promotion a day or two before it starts.

behaviours.name: Cautious first-timer
behaviours.how: Wants to send a small test and see it arrive before committing money.

behaviours.name: Hands it to someone else
behaviours.how: A staff member, nephew or agency handles the marketing; the owner approves the spend.

behaviours.name: Wants it plugged into the shop system
behaviours.how: Expects order confirmations to send automatically from the website, POS or WooCommerce.

objections: WhatsApp is free and my customers already read it there
Will my business name be approved in time for 11.11?
Do people even read SMS offers, or do they treat them as spam?
Credits that expire in 3 months: I don't send that often
I already have an SMS provider; why switch?
Will Sinhala and Tamil messages cost more credits?
I don't know how to upload my contact list or set it up
Is it legal to send promotions to people who bought from me?
habits: you go live on Facebook to sell new stock on weekends
you keep customer numbers in a notebook and an Excel sheet
Daraz and the big brands are all shouting about 11.11 this week
you already paid for boosted Facebook posts this month
your accountant asks you to cut costs every quarter
you reply to customer messages late at night on your phone
